explanation: The Cap-Français article opens its own account with the siege two months earlier: "The troops loyal to the commissioners commanded by generals Lassale and Beauvais besiege to Port-au-Prince, which is retaken on April 14, 1793." The commissioners hold the colony's two chief towns when the June conflict at the Cape begins. Precondition and not cause: the article places the siege behind the events at the Cape and argues nothing further. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
